Although the form itself is about precision, the texture is all about rhythm. I’m not worried about symmetry here, I’m chasing feeling. That raw, tactile surface that invites you to turn the piece over in your hands. #creatorsearchinsights Pottery and ceramics aren’t the same thing. Ceramics is the *umbrella* — everything made from clay and fired. Pottery is just one branch of it, focused on functional pieces like mugs, bowls, and vases. So yes, every pot is ceramic, but not every ceramic is a pot. #ceramics #pottery #ceramicart #clayartist
